name: Memoir
summary: Warm-greige creator blog with a sticky left sidebar profile, a centred Manrope headline with one italic serif word, and a calm 3-column grid of sunlit interior post cards.

fonts.pairing: Manrope 500 at -0.06em for headlines with a single Source Serif 4 italic word as the accent; Manrope 500 to 600 for everything else

signature: app-like sticky left sidebar with avatar, nav with counts, social links, a pinned post card and a mini subscribe field
headline set in tight grotesk with one word swapped to a serif italic for warmth
imagery: soft warm-light still lifes and desk interiors in beige, terracotta and oak, consistent colour grade across every card
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 240px fixed sidebar, content column about 890px with 3-column card grid, 12px card radii, 10px image radii
